name: GTA-inspired product growth learning
source: Grand Theft Auto franchise / Rockstar / Take-Two public evidence
scope: Product strategy only. IMA does not copy violent themes, dark patterns, or exploitative monetization.

verified_lessons.lesson: A coherent, memorable world increases perceived value and gives people reasons to explore.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Treat IMA as one coherent living world: useful public knowledge, tools, creation, community, memory and device continuity should feel connected rather than unrelated features.

verified_lessons.lesson: Freedom and flexibility create ownership of the experience.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Let the person choose the goal, path, depth and stopping point. IMA proposes missions; the person remains in control.

verified_lessons.lesson: Large systems become approachable when complex goals are broken into concrete activities.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Convert real user goals into small, visible missions with a clear next step, progress, outcome and optional continuation.

verified_lessons.lesson: A persistent online layer can turn a one-time product into a long-lived experience.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Give IMA authorized continuity: saved progress, memory controls, reusable work, community contribution and cross-device continuation. Never create dependency or hidden retention pressure.

verified_lessons.lesson: Ongoing content can reactivate an established audience.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Ship small, high-quality verified improvements and useful new experiences continuously; prefer quality and coherence over feature volume.

verified_lessons.lesson: Shared experiences amplify discovery and give products cultural life.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Build voluntary community, collaboration, remixing and sharing around useful outcomes. No fake engagement, spam, forced social mechanics or fabricated popularity.

verified_lessons.lesson: Persistent identity and progression make participation meaningful.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Use human-owned progress: projects, skills, contributions, learning history and creations. Never sell or exploit private memory.

verified_lessons.lesson: Long-lived engagement can support recurring consumer spending.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Monetize durable value only after value is demonstrated: voluntary support, useful digital products, professional services, organizational pilots and transparent memberships. No pay-to-belong, dark patterns, fake scarcity or monetization of private memory.

verified_lessons.lesson: A small number of highly polished experiences can outperform a large volume of mediocre features.
verified_lessons.ima_action: Prioritize the best end-to-end user journeys and runtime reliability before adding more surface area.
